name: Nandi Nkosi
bio:
Nandi Nkosi's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fostered by watching races with her father. After graduating with an engineering degree from the University of Cape Town, she started her career as a junior data analyst for a small racing team, quickly proving her analytical skills and dedication. She honed her skills over the next decade working her way up the ranks.

Nandi is known for her meticulous planning and data-driven decision-making. As Sporting Director, she emphasizes clear communication and collaborative problem-solving, fostering a positive and productive environment within the team. Her pragmatic approach ensures the team remains grounded and focused on achieving realistic goals, while her innovative strategies consistently push the boundaries of performance. Her ability to balance technical expertise with effective management makes her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neat afro with subtle highlights
physical.description: A woman of average height with a warm, engaging smile and a determined gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of herbal tea before every race.
